Great Food and Friendly Service at El Latino
Aug 2025 • Solo
I had a really enjoyable meal at El Latino. The tuna ceviche was fresh and full of flavor, and the quesadillas were warm, cheesy, and perfectly made. I also really liked the draught beer – smooth and refreshing.

The staff were excellent – very friendly and always checking in to make sure everything was okay. It felt like they genuinely cared about our experience, which made the visit even more pleasant.

One thing I found interesting was their variety of chili sauces – each one had a unique taste and added something special to the food.

It was a great experience overall, and I’ll definitely return next time!

Amazing food served by the best best of people
Feb 2025 • Couples
Can’t recommend this place enough. We visited 4 times while we stayed in the area and had food delivered by grab once as well. The food was all really tasty and reasonably priced, they have some excellent hot sauces made in Saigon which were really good also. 

The owner makes his own homemade desperados beer and honestly they went down an absolute treat, definitely worth a try. They also do fantastic cocktails, including Pesco sour which me and my girlfriend drank plenty of. 

The real standout of this establishment however is just how friendly and welcoming all of the staff are. I got chatting to the owner, a delightful Frenchman, and got talking about rugby. On our return he managed to rig up the 6 nations for us to watch late into the evening. It was a real shame we couldn’t watch the England vs France game as we had to leave early the next day. 

Usually on Friday and Saturday they have live music, the co-owner lady from the Philippines was performing on the Friday we were there and she was really excellent. Such a good voice and an amazing band supporting! 

If you’re looking for good food and drinks with some of the most welcoming people you’ll ever meet, look no further. After spending most evenings here we were genuinely sad to be leaving Mui Ne and El Latino as we came to see the staff there as good friends.

Not Good!
Feb 2025 • Couples
I didn’t expect to find amazing Mexican food in Vietnam, but I was still shocked by how bad this was—some of the worst I’ve ever had. The “special burrito” was a mushy, unappetizing mess, and the guacamole was completely bland. To make things worse, the chips were tiny and barely held up to dipping.

As someone who lived in Mexico and Central America for over six years, I know what even decent Mexican food should taste like, and this wasn’t it. If you’re craving real Mexican flavors, I’d recommend looking elsewhere.
